title: noccaea zangezurica
intro: Noccaea zangezurica, commonly known as Armenian penny-cress, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Noccaea zangezurica include its potential to act as an immunomodulator, antimicrobial agent, and antioxidant, making it a candidate for the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Noccaea zangezurica include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
